oracle.name: Power Pages
oracle.scope: Two signed-in runs on 2026-11-26 (f1, f2) of an edit basic form whose ticker column is bound only to a usage=input property of an invented probe control (Control Style Code Component): the column's hidden input as served, posted unchanged by the form's submit, and the Dataverse read-back of the column. Establishes that the save keeps the stored value; not the control's parameters or other columns.
